subject: Class 455 in South West Trains red as South Western Railway ran it to the end (2026-03-20), refurbished front
method: Bodyside from the Unisouth SWT diagram (dia), axes calibrated separately and checked against 455864 (p864) and 77742 (pvx) by 1D projective fits along the window row; face from the near head-on long-lens photo of 455861 (p861), the gangway frame from p920; livery sweep from the diagram, checked on p864 and pvx; colours sampled from p864 against the white wordmark. No camera match (no Blender in this pass).

calibration.notes: Horizontal: bogie centres 267 and 1285 px (wheels 172/362 and 1190/1380) = 1018 px for the published 14.17 m -> 71.84 px/m; the cab car then reads 101..1524 px = 19.81 m (published DTSO 19.83 m) with the front at the old gangway's rubber (101 px), the face itself at 123 px. All x in this spec are from the face (123 px). Vertical: rail 345 (wheel bottoms) to roof 38 = 307 px for 3.77 m -> 81.4 px/m, 13% more than horizontally. The second car (MSO) is drawn 1376 px (19.15 m) for a published 19.92 m, its door spacing the cab car's (499 px) and its ends short, so its features are placed from its centre (2269 px). Same template as the 317/318/320 diagrams (identical door and wheel pixels).

trace.heights.bottom: dia: body bottom row 272 -> 0.897 m; p864 column u=2000 puts the red's lower edge at 0.86 m (curved, in shade), within 4 cm.
trace.heights.cantrail: dia: roof band ends at row 56 -> 3.55 m. On p864 the red carries on above the orange line to the roof's curve (sky reflection band), agreeing with the diagram rather than the line.
trace.heights.roof: dia: row 38 -> 3.77 m (published height 3.77 m: this is the vertical calibration).
trace.heights.window: dia: window glass rows 97..175 -> 3.047..2.088 m (frames 92..180 -> 3.108..2.027). p864 column u=1600: frame 1179..1389 px; the 1.081 m frame height is what scales the wordmark there.
trace.wheel: Template wheel 30 px grey disc + rims (BP20 bogie), 0.84 m as the 318/320 specs on the same template.
trace.wheelbase: dia: axles 172/362 px = 190 px = 2.645 m; 2.6 m kept, the BR BP20 bogie's figure used on the 318/320 specs from the same template.
trace.cab.length: dia: face (123 px) to the rear end (1524 px) = 19.50 m. With the gangway frame's 0.30 m that is 19.80 m, the published DTSO 19.83 m.
trace.cab.doors[0]: Cab door: dia outline 212..277 px -> 1.239..2.144 m (centre 1.69, w 0.905); p864 fit puts its far edge at 2.09 m (row 1330, u 2146). Window: dia 228..262 px, rows 102..179 -> x 1.462..1.935 (panes -0.228..0.245 from the centre), y 2.985..2.039. Span: outline rows ~78..262 -> 3.33..1.0.
trace.cab.doors[1,2]: Centres: dia 586.5 and 1085.5 px -> 6.452 and 13.398 m; p864 fit through the windows only (held-out window edge 0.6 cm) puts the yellow surrounds' near edges at 5.389/12.321 and the door centres at 6.468/13.415: 6.46 and 13.41 used. Leaves w 1.52: p864 row 1450, door 1's blue leaves start 5.92 and the leaf edge (dark seal) 5.70 on the near side -> half 0.76 about the centre; the diagram draws them 1.74 (125 px), too wide like the 318/320 template (published opening 1.010 m). Leaf windows: dia rows 93..167 -> 3.096..2.187 m; across the leaf scaled from the diagram's 0.216..0.675 of a 0.87 leaf to the measured 0.76 -> 0.19..0.55. Span: dia leaves rows 74..266 -> 3.33..0.97.
trace.cab.windows: Glass, dia row 140: 353..473, 700..820, 852..972, 1199..1319, 1351..1471 px -> 3.202..4.872, 8.032..9.702, 10.148..11.818, 14.978..16.648, 17.094..18.764 m. Checked on p864 (1D projective fit on the frames' outer edges, row 1330: residuals 0.1-5.4 cm, held-out 0.6 cm) and pvx (residuals 3-8 cm). The first entry, 0.766..1.169, is the fixed cab side window ahead of the cab door (dia 178..207 px, rows 101..163 -> 3.0..2.236 m; p864 and pvx agree within 4 cm): drawn at the class's window heights here, 15 cm too low at its bottom (no per-window heights in CarSpec).
trace.cab.bogies: dia: bogie centres 267 and 1285 px -> 2.004 and 16.175 m from the face.
trace.next: MSO from its centre (dia 2269 px, its ends drawn short): doors at +-249.5 px = +-3.473 m about 9.96 m -> 6.487 and 13.433 (the cab car's door spacing, 6.95 m, is confirmed on p864: 6.947 m); glass +-(0.223..1.893), +-(5.053..6.723), +-(7.169..8.839) m about the centre; bogies at the published 14.17 m centres, 2.875 and 17.045; underframe 1972..2570 px -> +-4.15 m about the centre. No pantograph (third rail). A 455/7's third car is the ex-508 TSO; the rendered second car is the MSO in every sub-class.
trace.nose.profile: Face upright from 0.85 to 3.45 m (dia: face at 123 px from row 60 to 268; p861 and p864 show it flat), then the roof curve: dia leftmost non-white per row, rows 56/52/48/44/40/38 -> x 0.056/0.14/0.25/0.38/0.57/0.77 m back at 3.55/3.60/3.649/3.698/3.747/3.77 m.
trace.face.scale: p861 (Canon R50, 93 mm, about 14 deg yaw from the left, tan 0.242 from the cab side window's 38 px for 0.403 m): centre line u0=3004 px (yellow panel edges 2455/3545 and the two screens' centres agree within 2.5 px), 388.7 px/m from the right silhouette's 548 px for the 1.41 m half-width; heights y = 0.897 + (1405 - v)/388.7 (body bottom at the red band's lower edge, v 1405). Check: the waist (yellow top) reads 2.062 m against the diagram's window frame bottom 2.027 and glass 2.088; the roof ridge reads 3.71 (it stands behind the face).
trace.face.panel: Yellow: v 952..1320 -> 2.062..1.116 m, edge to edge (both corners, the yellow wraps round them).
trace.face.dark: Destination displays: left 2532..2768, right 3249..3477 px -> m 0.62..1.216 (mean of both sides), v 518..588 -> 3.179..2.999 m.
trace.face.lines: The blue moulded surround of each screen and display: 2507..2794 / 3215..3500 px, v 503..950 -> m 0.56..1.27, y 2.068..3.218.
trace.face.lights: Lamp housing: 2518..2732 and 3279..3477 px, v 1208..1309 -> m 0.704..1.234 (mean), y 1.144..1.404; a rectangular recessed box painted yellow round a dark interior.
trace.face.lampUnits: Head (round reflector) outboard at 2610/3405 px -> m 1.023, r 36 px = 0.093; LED cluster (marker/tail, white dots unlit, red when lit on p920) inboard at 2688/3327 -> m 0.822, r 32 px = 0.082; both at v 1260 -> 1.27 m. Same order on p701, p733, p920 (head outboard).
trace.face.gangway: Door: yellow 2895..3140 px less the frame's 19 px shift -> +-0.316 m; top at the opening 550 px -> 3.097; bottom 1381 -> 0.959. Window 2929..3097 px (shifted) -> +-0.216 m, v 638..929 -> 2.870..2.122 m; above the yellow (2.062) the door is blue, red strip 1.100..0.959 at the bottom: not representable (the pipeline's door is one colour, no window).
trace.face.gangwayFrame: Outer 2804..3243 px less the 19 px shift -> +-0.565 m; bars 85 px = 0.22 m wide each side; top 446 px -> 3.364 m with 0.17 m corners; bottom 1427 -> 0.84 m. Colour: unpainted, studded steel (sample frame-861). Depth 0.30 m from the diagram's front gangway (101..123 px); the head-on shift on p861 suggests 0.14-0.21 m and p920 shows the door set back inside the frame by about as much as the frame stands out: open question.
trace.face.shapes: Red band under the yellow: v 1320..1405 -> 1.116..0.897 m, carried to 0.85 m (headstock edge). Orange line ends on the face corners: 2450..2502 px and 3505..3550, v 533..541 -> m 1.29..1.42, y 3.115..3.145.
trace.face.number: '5861' black on the yellow above each lamp housing: centres 2629/3372 px -> m 0.956 (mean), v 1168 -> 1.505 m; height 40 px = 0.10 m.
trace.face.wipers: Pivot at the top of each screen, blade hanging outwards: pivots 2663/3351 px v 609 -> m 0.886, y 2.945; tips 2568/3452 px v 777/782 -> m 1.137, y 2.507.
trace.form: Width 2.82 m published; tumblehome 0.1 and squareness 8 as the 320 (same Mk3-derived body); corner setback 0.12 m from the rounded corners on p920 and p864; glazing in gaskets with grey frames.
trace.liveries.SW.colours: Balanced against the white wordmark stroke white-864 (sun; the stroke is partly clipped, so the balance under-corrects): red-864 #E74041, blue-864 #325BC9, orange-864 #F0A93E, yellow-864 #EED255, doorblue-864 #5365A8. Red is the mean of red-864 and red-wm (#BB332D, balanced against white-wm under station light) = #D13A37. Face yellow and gangway door use the door-surround yellow (the face's samples are in shade with no neutral: #885D1B/#9D6E2B/#C18D18, same hue). Roof: roof-uh #6D5F70 (sky-tinted, no neutral) taken half way to grey, #6A6468. Frame: frame-861 #38475E as sampled.
trace.liveries.SW.shapes: Cab-end sweep from the diagram (per-row extents of #000080 and #FF8000 on the cab side, sweep.py), smoothed with a spline (max residual 4 cm) and sampled every 0.25 m: blue ahead of B, orange from B to O. Checked on p864 (row 1450, y about 2.1: blue from 1.25, orange to about 1.95) and pvx (row 790, y about 2.0: blue from 1.11, orange 1.15..1.87 then the cab door's edge to 2.22) against the diagram's 1.23/2.09 at those heights: within 15 cm.
trace.liveries.SW.rects: Orange cantrail line: dia rows 65..67 -> 3.425..3.445 m, full length on both cars. Orange waist line: dia rows 220..223 -> 1.517..1.554 m; on the cab car from behind the wordmark to the rear end (dia: from 852 px, behind the old logo; p864 shows it from door 2 back), on the MSO full length less the wordmark (p864 s-mso crop). Door surrounds: yellow bands on the body either side of the leaves, 0.29 m wide (dia 21 px; p864 door 1 near side 5.405..5.70), from the leaf edge at +-0.76 to +-1.05 about each door centre, rows 74..268 -> 0.97..3.33 m. The yellow is carried over the top of each door, 0.07 m deep (p864 and p004 show a yellow arch; second reader agrees; the drawing omits it).
trace.liveries.SW.branding: SWR wordmark (arrow + 'South Western Railway', white vinyl) on each car between doors 1 and 2. Cab car: p864 1D fit puts it at 8.70..11.70 m, pvx at 8.43..11.27 -> centre 10.0, length 3.0 m; height 3.0 / the traced artwork's aspect 8.4 = 0.357 m (p864: the S's cap height 59 px = 0.30 m at 194 px/m, the box 1.2 times that); centre y 1.49 (p864 1.49, pvx 1.50). MSO: between its doors, centred (p864). Artwork: classes/455/logo/SW-wordmark.svg traced from pwm (needs moving to logos/SW-wordmark.svg); logos/SW.svg is the stacked logo and is not what these cars carry.
trace.face.heights: 2026-10-06: every face height moved by y' = 1.167 + 0.93 (y - 0.897). Camera matches on p864 and p701 both put the face 0.24-0.32 m higher relative to the bodyside windows than p861's anchor (red band foot = 0.897) gave; the p864 horizons agree (windows: camera 2.47 m above rail, old face 2.2 m) and so does the leading wheel. With this map p861's roof ridge reads 3.78 (published 3.77). Across (z) left as measured. The y values in face.* traces above are the pre-correction ones. Below the red band (now 1.123..1.371) the face is the dark headstock and buffer beam down to 0.85 (f-panel-861, p864, p701): a #2E3033 shape, so the lifted red band does not leave a deep red skirt (the 06:30 render showed one).
